Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Automatically price eligible inventory and reprice existing listings one gil below matching competition using Universalis market prices and recent sale history.
Punchline: Automatically price new and existing retainer listings.
Changelog: Fixes Auto update when the retainer greeting dialogue must be advanced and listing stacks above 99. Adds editable price-drop review bands, a Sniper minimum listing value, sortable server and listing columns, and keeps 1-gil alerts visible.
